column1: # threads OpenMP thread count, 1 for serial kernels
# Vector kernels require gcv. The driver rejects vector kernels with gc.
# Each unique (build, cflags) pair gets its own library + benchmark binary.
# cflags are recorded in the CSV to keep compile-time sweeps distinct.
#   omp threads vs omp 1  parallel scaling of the baseline source
# The omp rows build the baseline source with OpenMP and the vectorizer off,
# so they are the baseline plus threads and nothing else, and run_bench.sh
# rejects the build if the kernel contains any RVV instruction. They run
# pinned one thread per physical core: taskset -c OMP_CPUS (default 0-7) with
